predeclared_local_image_gate.rule: Both fixed model-only learner seeds strictly beat frozen-anchor shifted-repeat image MSE in both development action-source strata, with four independent complete road episodes per stratum.

limits: The separately pinned development collection preceded final scorer implementation; development road/source/metric gate/window/latent seed were predeclared before reset, but final scorer bytes and all development archive hashes were frozen only before ZIP decoding/prediction scoring. This is not a blinded or fresh holdout.

Training source0/source1 are two actor attempts on the same twelve road IDs, not twenty-four independent geometries; their union-support gate never retroactively changed source0's failed standalone gate.
The mixed teacher model uses 10,612 decisions whereas the old random archive uses 4,137; no new random student model or matched random-versus-teacher learner trial occurred in this study.

Only one learner seed had a tiny below-repeat image value on source0-action roads, while the other seed and both random-action cases failed. Post hoc seed selection cannot replace the registered two-seed/two-stratum gate.
Four terminal events but no finished development road in each stratum cannot support independent finish prediction or student driving claims.
No Dreamer actor/critic training, private/held-out/confirmation/blind evaluation, fresh P1b result, model promotion or official HAIC score was produced.
